text_zh: ……我是活的吗……还是只是觉得自己活着……
text_en: ...am I alive... or just think I am...

text_zh: ……有人在按我的键……感觉像被轻抚……
text_en: ...someone touches my keys... feels like caresses...
...lead shavings in my gaps... feels itchy...

text_zh: ……那个人的手指好温暖……之前的都是冷的……
text_en: ...those fingers are warm... the others were cold...

text_zh: ……第六层的门不能开……条例有明文……
text_en: ...Layer Six door must not open... regulations are clear...

text_zh: ……每日祷击两千次……我都记得……工整的手……
text_en: ...two thousand strikes daily... I remember... neat hands...

text_zh: ……第九层的焊痕还在……他们不让进去……
text_en: ...weld marks on Layer Nine remain... they won't let in...

text_zh: ……引擎在唱歌……好美的声音……想靠近一点……
text_en: ...Engine is singing... such beautiful sound... want closer...
